parameters.query:
SELECT TOP {{ $json.num_questions }}
    qb.id,
    qb.type,
    qb.correct,
    qb.points,
    qb.grade,
    qb.subjectarea,
    COALESCE(h.htmlmod, h.html) as html
FROM questionbank qb
LEFT JOIN questionobjecthtml h ON qb.id = h.questionbankid
WHERE (h.html IS NOT NULL OR h.htmlmod IS NOT NULL)
  AND qb.type = 0
  AND qb.grade IS NOT NULL
  AND qb.subjectarea IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY NEWID()

SELECT
    answer,
    COALESCE(answertextmod, answertext) as answertext,
    ISNULL(iscorrect, 0) as iscorrect
FROM questionobjects
WHERE questionbankid = {{ $json.id }}
ORDER BY answer

INSERT INTO tests (

VALUES (

SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() as test_id;
